'''Pann Tefilous''' was a former [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who organized [[Starship/Legends|starship]] races during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Tefilous was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and a [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] before beginning a new career running illegal starship races and approached racers such as [[Siro Simito]], to persuade them to participate. During the [[Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade]], a race Tefilous had organized in the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]], the promoter traveled to [[Ord Dorlass]], where the racers stopped over for one of the stages of the race. Simito and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] racer [[Seeg]] staged a fight in a bar and were arrested. This increased the race's popularity among the local inhabitants and when they were released the next day, Tefilous informed them that their popularity in the planet had risen by six points.<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>
